description:
`crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/encoding/richardson_urbanke.rs` and `RuEncodingMatrices` are named after Richardson-Urbanke encoding, while the code reduces the parity-check matrix to RREF and stores a dense parity matrix.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The module and type names describe the implemented method, or the module implements Richardson-Urbanke encoding with its approximate-lower-triangular preprocessing, cited through the citation registry.
- [hard] REQ-02: No superseded alias remains, per `@/inv/canonical-cutover`.
title: RuEncodingMatrices names an algorithm the encoder does not implement
